judge.rationale: The candidate polluted the diff with over 120KB of unrelated Prettier formatting changes across markdown, YAML, and documentation files outside `src/`, and committed a `.lore/dod.md` tracking artifact into the repository. While `CHANGELOG.md` and `.lore/dod.md` indicate the candidate implemented usage summation across tool rounds and added acceptance tests, it placed those tests in a separate `src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and linking them in the architecture/hook specs as the reference did. Furthermore, the `OrchestratorHooks` doc-block in `CLAUDE.md` was not updated with the `totalUsage` parameter name, which would either fail doc-block verification or indicate the hook signature in `chatOrchestrator.ts` was not updated the same way as the reference. Because of the massive unrelated formatting churn and leftover `.lore/dod.md` file, the branch could not be merged as-is.
